crossRefs.note: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children…
Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and…
the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
